authentication.flow: Unauthenticated tool response requests browser login; subsequent invocation exchanges pending device code and resumes request. Tools discovery can succeed before login.
authentication.storageOwner: Official vendor process, not DSH credential vault
authentication.permissions: Source attempts POSIX directory 0700/file 0600; permission errors are caught. No local credential file was read.
